subject.title: 请求支持 Telegram Bot 命令菜单中文化

question: Should the remaining Telegram command-menu localization work stay as a Telegram-focused `descriptionLocalizations` config/built-in command contract, or be consolidated into the broader slash-command description i18n tracker?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds or extends a public config/API surface and requires translation ownership and locale-selection policy.

options.title: Keep focused Telegram tracker
options.body: Use this issue to define Telegram custom/built-in command description localization with the existing locale-map shape and leave broader UI/Gateway i18n to related work.

options.title: Consolidate into broader i18n issue
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/79458 the canonical tracker only if maintainers explicitly decide it owns Telegram config and built-in command descriptions too.

options.title: Defer config localization
options.body: Keep only plugin-supplied `descriptionLocalizations` for now and do not add built-in or user-configurable Chinese command descriptions.

recommendation.title: Keep focused Telegram tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue to define Telegram custom/built-in command description localization with the existing locale-map shape and leave broader UI/Gateway i18n to related work.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history across Telegram menu localization, custom command config, and native command localization plumbing.
